edges.reason: flashLoan invokes external callback onFlashLoan on an untrusted receiver contract
onFlashLoan callback returns control to flashLoan allowing reentrant calls into vault entry points
withdrawNFTsTo makes an external ERC1155 safeTransferFrom call to an untrusted recipient
withdrawNFTsTo invokes external eligibility afterRedeemHook after state mutations
transferERC721 performs an arbitrary low-level call to the asset contract
transferFromERC721 performs an arbitrary low-level call to the asset contract
_chargeAndDistributeFees calls external fee distributor distribute while minted fees are in flight
msg.sender is used as the from address for pulling the caller's NFTs
msg.sender is checked against excludedFromFees to decide fee skipping
msg.sender is compared against owner or manager in onlyPrivileged
msg.sender is compared against owner in onlyOwnerIfPaused
block.timestamp is fed into the pseudo-random index generation, creating timestamp dependence
block.timestamp influences the random token id selection, making selection timestamp dependent
randNonce is incremented alongside the randomness derivation
getRandomTokenIdFromVault reads holdings.at to pick a token id
mintTo computes base*count and mintFee()*count
mintTo mints share tokens to the recipient
mintTo invokes _chargeAndDistributeFees with the computed total fee
mintTo calls receiveNFTs to pull NFTs and obtain the mint count
redeemTo burns vault shares from the caller
redeemTo computes totalFee combining target and random redeem fees
redeemTo charges the computed redeem fee
redeemTo calls withdrawNFTsTo to send NFTs to the recipient
swapTo accumulates count and computes totalFee from swap fees
swapTo charges the computed swap fee
swapTo calls withdrawNFTsTo first to send NFTs out
swapTo calls receiveNFTs to deposit the swapped-in NFTs
receiveNFTs updates quantity1155[tokenId] and count with unchecked-style additions
receiveNFTs performs ERC1155 safeBatchTransferFrom to pull tokens into the vault
receiveNFTs calls allValidNFTs to validate eligibility before intake
receiveNFTs adds newly received token ids to holdings
receiveNFTs increments quantity1155 for ERC1155 assets
withdrawNFTsTo decrements quantity1155[tokenId] by one
withdrawNFTsTo calls transferERC721 to move ERC721 assets to the recipient
withdrawNFTsTo removes token ids from holdings
withdrawNFTsTo decrements quantity1155 for ERC1155 assets
_chargeAndDistributeFees transfers the fee amount to the fee distributor
_chargeAndDistributeFees invokes the fee distributor distribute function
transferERC721 executes the constructed calldata through a low-level call
transferFromERC721 executes the constructed calldata through a low-level call
transferFromERC721 staticcalls punkIndexToAddress to verify CryptoPunks ownership
afterRedeemHook reads the eligibilityStorage module and calls it
allValidNFTs reads eligibilityStorage to check eligibility
deployEligibilityStorage writes the new eligibility module into eligibilityStorage
setManager is guarded by onlyPrivileged
setFees is guarded by onlyPrivileged
setVaultFeatures is guarded by onlyPrivileged
deployEligibilityStorage is guarded by onlyPrivileged
setVaultMetadata is guarded by onlyPrivileged
mintTo checks onlyOwnerIfPaused lock id 1
redeemTo checks onlyOwnerIfPaused lock id 2
swapTo checks onlyOwnerIfPaused lock id 3
flashLoan checks onlyOwnerIfPaused lock id 4
tokenIds parameter is consumed by receiveNFTs for NFT intake
amounts parameter is consumed by receiveNFTs for ERC1155 intake
to parameter flows into withdrawNFTsTo as the NFT recipient
tokenIds parameter flows into mintTo from the external mint entry point
amount parameter is used by redeemTo to burn vault shares
specificIds parameter is used by redeemTo to select target NFTs
local count derived from receiveNFTs scales the minted share amount
local totalFee flows into _chargeAndDistributeFees
local tokenId is used in the quantity1155 arithmetic inside receiveNFTs
local feeDistributor is the target of the external distribute call
local randomIndex is used to select a token id from holdings
mint forwards execution to mintTo using msg.sender
redeem forwards execution to redeemTo using msg.sender
swap forwards execution to swapTo using msg.sender

normalization_plan.reason: tokenIds is a caller-supplied parameter consumed directly by receiveNFTs for NFT intake
amounts is a caller-supplied parameter consumed directly by receiveNFTs for ERC1155 intake
to is the recipient parameter that flows directly into withdrawNFTsTo
amount is the share amount parameter consumed by redeemTo
specificIds is the target id parameter consumed by redeemTo
count is a local derived from receiveNFTs and used in mintTo to compute minted shares
totalFee is a local computed fee passed into _chargeAndDistributeFees
tokenId is a local used in the quantity1155 arithmetic inside receiveNFTs
feeDistributor is a local address used as the target of the external distribute call
randomIndex is a local computed in getRandomTokenIdFromVault and used to index holdings
